title: Unique Dark - More Green
description: Add-On for Unique Dark | Changes some blue to green
body:
This is a fan-made color accent extension created for everyone who loves [Unique Dark](https://modrinth.com/resourcepack/unique-dark), but prefers a green color scheme over the original blue. It changes most of vanilla blue-highlighted elements of interface to green-highlighted.

Inspired by [Unique Dark - Green Interface](https://modrinth.com/resourcepack/unique-dark-green)

Requires [Unique Dark](https://modrinth.com/resourcepack/unique-dark)

All credits for the base UI go to [amongstreality](https://modrinth.com/user/amongstreality)
